description:
Return the list of individual physical devices matching one or more (brand, model) pairs
for which we have battery statistics. Each entry in the returned list describes ONE specific
device (identified by its own `device_uid`) and the metrics on that entry are aggregates
computed only from THAT device's own snapshot history — they are not aggregated across
devices. Two devices of the same brand and model will appear as two separate entries with
their own independent metrics.

Per-device fields include: brand, resolved model (street name), raw Android model, snapshot
count, activity window (first / last seen), average battery level, average / min / max
battery temperature in Celsius, awake-ratio, discharge speed and AC / USB / wireless charge
speed (hours per full 100% swing), Android SDK level, IANA time zone, and a `url` pointing at the
public BatterySnap web page for the device's interactive battery history
(https://www.battery-snap.com/device_history?device=<uid>).

Each pair's model is matched case-insensitively against either the resolved street name
(e.g. 'Galaxy S23') or the raw Android model identifier (e.g. 'SM-S911B').
Pass `fields` to keep only specific attributes per device and avoid bloated responses.

fields.description: Optional whitelist of attribute names to keep in each returned entry, used to shrink the response. When omitted or empty, all attributes documented in the output schema are returned. Unknown names are silently ignored.

pairs.description: One or more {brand, model} pairs to look up. Each pair fetches devices matching that brand and model.

brand.description: Lowercase Android device brand identifier (e.g. 'samsung', 'xiaomi'), matched case-insensitively against the device's brand.

model.description: Model name matched case-insensitively against either the resolved street name (e.g. 'Galaxy S23') or the raw Android model identifier (e.g. 'SM-S911B').

name: devices

android_api_level.description: Android SDK API level reported by the device (e.g. 28 = Pie, 34 = Android 14).

avg_ac_charge_hours_per_full_charge.description: Average hours to charge a full 100% on an AC wall charger. Lower is faster.

avg_battery_level_percent.description: Mean battery charge level across all snapshots, in percent (normally 0-100; may be outside that range for corrupted samples). Null if no level samples.

avg_battery_temperature_celsius.description: Mean battery temperature in Celsius, across all snapshots. Null if no temperature samples.

avg_discharge_hours_per_full_charge.description: Average hours to discharge a full 100% while running on battery (e.g. 40 means the battery lasts ~40 h from full to empty at this device's usage). Higher is better battery life.

avg_usb_charge_hours_per_full_charge.description: Average hours to charge a full 100% over USB (e.g. a computer port). Typically slower than AC.

avg_wireless_charge_hours_per_full_charg.description: Average hours to charge a full 100% wirelessly. Null if the device never charged wirelessly.

awake_time_fraction.description: Fraction of observed time the device was awake / screen-on (normally between 0 and 1).

brand.description: Lowercase Android device brand identifier this device belongs to (e.g. 'samsung', 'xiaomi').

device_uid.description: Stable UUID identifying this device across snapshots.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the earliest battery snapshot recorded for this device. Null if unknown.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent battery snapshot recorded for this device. Null if unknown.

max_battery_temperature_celsius.description: Hottest battery temperature in Celsius observed across all snapshots for this device. Sustained high values are a battery-health concern. Null if no temperature samples.

min_battery_temperature_celsius.description: Coldest battery temperature in Celsius observed across all snapshots for this device. Null if no temperature samples.

raw_model.description: Raw Android model identifier reported by the device (e.g. 'SM-G960F'). This is the value the device sends in Build.MODEL.

snapshot_count.description: Total number of battery snapshots recorded for this device. Higher values mean the per-device aggregates are based on more samples and are more reliable.

street_name.description: Human-readable model name resolved for this device (e.g. 'Galaxy S23', 'Pixel 7a'). Null when the model could not be resolved from the raw Android identifiers.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier reported by the device (e.g. 'Europe/Paris', 'America/New_York'). Indicates the geographic region the device is operating in. Null when unknown.

url.description: Public BatterySnap web page showing this device's interactive battery history, e.g. https://www.battery-snap.com/device_history?device=<uid>. Locale-agnostic — server 301-redirects to the visitor's locale.

title: Find devices by model
